meta.name: Sky News
meta.description:
Sky News is a world class breaking news service with a spirit of innovation and a fresh approach to news broadcasting. As the UK's first dedicated 24-hour news channel, Sky News has built a deserved reputation for being the first to break major news.

Shows: Sky News Today with Jayne Secker, Sky News Today, The News Hour with Mark Austin, The Wrap With Anna Botting, The News Hour with Jonathan Samuels
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
